text:
elaine: heads-up, ember8b-int6 bring-up quick thread 34 need a GTN-ready econ + quality capsule by EOD :hourglass:
matt: quick summary: int6 reduces spend vs int8/float32 baselines but we see a precision hit on some longform slices. numbers below.

raj: infra perf — p50 ~95ms, p95 ~150ms on V100 pool w/ cold cache; warmed-kv expected to raise throughput ~12-18%. current KV hit ~29%. throughput ~13 rps/gpu at avg seq=200.

matt: unit econ snapshot (rough):
```
cost_per_token: $0.0007
avg_tokens_per_req: 240
reqs_per_min_per_gpu: 780
unit_cost_per_request: ~$0.17
cost_delta_vs_int8: -18%
cost_delta_vs_float32: -38%
```

lucy: quality notes: short Q&A & instruction tasks look comparable. longform summarization and multi-paragraph extraction show entity drops and fluency regressions; ROUGE-L down ~2.6 vs float baseline, entity-precision down ~3%.

elaine: product wants an explicit triage: green / amber / red for GTN. one-line recommendation pls.

lucy: amber 34 allow interactive chat, RAG, and short answers. block longform summarizer and major API summarization endpoints until we validate priming fixes.

raj: ops asks: run two canaries: (A) 3% traffic chat with warm-kv true, (B) 0% to summarizer routes. measure p95, KV hit, and token spend. bump KV TTL for the canary run.

matt: proposed experiments to reduce regression: 1) prefix warmstart + shorter context-window priming 2) ensemble decode with fp16 candidate rescoring 3) post-hoc hallucination classifier on summarization slice.

elaine: perfect. ops-bot, schedule canary and flag GTN doc as amber with a one-paragraph blurb.

ops-bot: canary scheduled: ember8b-int6 -> 2026-04-01T12:00Z, A: 3% chat routes (warm-kv: true), B: 0% longform summarizers, geo: us-east-1 :white_check_mark:

lucy: I'll assemble a 6-slide deck with slice examples, per-slice metrics, and the top-3 hypotheses + test plan.
matt: I'll run warmed-cache perf sweep and post updated unit econ numbers tomorrow AM.

elaine: GTN blurb suggestion: "Ember8b-int6 yields meaningful token-cost reduction with parity on short-form tasks; regressions on multi-paragraph summarization recommend gated rollout for chat/QA and hold for summarizers pending priming/ensemble mitigations."

matt: noted. adding a note to the canary ticket to capture decode samples for the hallucination classifier training set.

elaine: thanks all 34 actionable and concise. we'll brief GTN tomorrow with lucy/matt. :thumbsup:
